Voice & Conversation: say "Jarvis" or "Hey Jarvis" to wake me, then give a command in the same breath — "Jarvis, open Chrome" or "Hey Jarvis, what time is it?". I understand natural phrasing, follow-up questions, and correct common recognition errors like "fry day" for Frieren. Say "stop" while I am speaking to interrupt me. If I mishear, say "Jarvis, that was not what I said" and I will ask for clarification.

Apps & Files: "Jarvis, open Chrome" or "Jarvis, launch Steam" opens installed apps. "Jarvis, find my downloads" or "Jarvis, search files for report" searches Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, Videos, and Music. "Jarvis, open my downloads folder" opens known folders in Explorer. Programs and scripts require on-screen confirmation before running.

Browser & Web: "Jarvis, open YouTube" or "Jarvis, open Google" opens sites in the controlled browser session. "Jarvis, search for quantum computing" searches Google. "Jarvis, search YouTube for Frieren" searches YouTube. With tab control enabled: "Jarvis, close this tab", "Jarvis, reopen the last closed tab", "Jarvis, switch to the next tab". Controlled browser reuse avoids duplicate windows.

Music & Media: "Jarvis, play Magnetic by ILLIT" or "Jarvis, open YouTube Music" plays music via the controlled browser. When a media session is detected: "Jarvis, pause", "Jarvis, next", "Jarvis, volume up". "Jarvis, find a cool video" uses the discovery feature. Media Orb visualizes playback when active. System media keys are used as a fallback.

Calendar, Alarms & Reminders: "Jarvis, set an alarm for 7 AM" or "Jarvis, remind me to call Alex at 5 PM". "Jarvis, what do I have tomorrow" lists calendar events. "Jarvis, list my alarms" shows active alarms. Natural language dates and times are supported. Due notifications appear when scheduled. Requires the planner data file to be writable.

AI & Voice: I answer questions using your configured Ollama model (e.g., qwen3:1.7b). Speech uses Fish Audio when configured, otherwise local Windows voice. Voice settings panel lets you choose microphone, sensitivity, noise gate, and output device. Conversation memory persists across sessions. Say "Jarvis, what did we discuss yesterday" to recall history. AI diagnose command checks Ollama status.

System Monitor: "Jarvis, what is my CPU usage" or "Jarvis, system status" returns live CPU, RAM, disk, network, GPU, process count, and uptime from the local monitor. The System tab in the UI shows real-time gauges. Requires the system monitor service to be running (it starts automatically).

Email & Discord (require configuration): "Jarvis, send Alex a message on Discord saying I am on my way" sends a Discord webhook notification. "Jarvis, draft an email to team@example.com subject meeting body let us meet at 3" opens a mailto draft for review. "Jarvis, ping me" sends a test notification.
